# Hilaris Publishing SRL

> > Hilaris Publishing SRL is an independent academic publisher specializing in open access journals across multiple scientific disciplines with global multilingual support.

Hilaris Publishing SRL operates a comprehensive open access journal platform serving the global research community. The publisher maintains versions in 10 languages (English, Spanish, Chinese, Russian, German, French, Japanese, Portuguese, Hindi, and Telugu/Tamil) to ensure accessibility across international academic communities.

## Editorial Standards & Ethics

- [Editorial Policies | Hilaris SRL](https://www.hilarispublisher.com/editorial-policies.html): Editorial policies and publication ethics standards for Hilaris journals

- [Reviewer Guidelines | HILARIS SRL](https://www.hilarispublisher.com/reviewer-guidelines.html): Guidelines for peer reviewers on manuscript evaluation and standards
